result.rationale: The migration runs `execute("SELECT c.id ... WHERE s.name = 'embed_category'")[0]['id']` unconditionally. On any install where the embed_category site setting was never set (e.g., fresh installs, since embed_category default was '' and may not exist as a row), the result set is empty, [0] is nil, and ['id'] raises NoMethodError, aborting the migration for all sites. The guard `if category_id == 0` only covers a present-but-unmatched row, not an absent one. This is verifiable directly from the diff.
